t: You're looking at a statue of Isaac Watts, set among the graves of Abney Park Cemetery. Watts was an English minister, theologian and logician, and he is best remembered as a hymn writer. He is credited with around 750 hymns, including Joy to the World, When I Survey the Wondrous Cross, and Our God, Our Help in Ages Past. He is often called the Godfather of English Hymnody. The statue is by Edward Hodges Baily, a prolific sculptor who also made the figure of Nelson on top of Nelson's Column, and carved friezes for Marble Arch and Buckingham Palace.
